hypotheses.F0_semantic_family_route_transfers: On both corpora, leave-one-pair-out same-family routes exceed outside-family routes by at least 0.05 median removal target projection.
hypotheses.F1_generic_broadcast_route_explains_tran: On both corpora, the global leave-pair-out route is within 0.05 of the same-family route and the outside-family route is within 0.05 of it.
hypotheses.F2_lexical_pair_route_is_required: On both corpora, the pair-specific discovery route exceeds the same-family route by at least 0.05 median removal target projection.
hypotheses.F3_cross_pair_routes_are_causal: Same-family and global routes each reach at least 0.05 median removal target projection on both corpora and exceed their cyclic-head-shift controls by at least 1.5x.
hypotheses.F4_oracle_gap_remains: On both corpora, per-example oracle-64 exceeds the best frozen route by at least 0.05 median removal target projection.
